name: Ansible Galaxy collections
auth: Use an access or reference token as the HTTP Basic password, with AW_USER equal to its subject. The subject needs read permission for installation and deploy permission for publication on the selected repository; token scopes cannot exceed that identity. The same clients also accept a user password when Basic password authentication is enabled. Use HTTPS.
fresh_home: Create a new AW_WORK with mktemp -d for every run; client configuration, downloads and caches in the commands stay under this directory. Do not reuse it to prove a fresh download. Remove the temporary directory after use.
prerequisites: A valid Galaxy collection with namespace weave, name sample and version 1.0.0.

configure.code:
umask 077
AW_WORK=$(mktemp -d)
mkdir -p "$AW_WORK/home"
cat > "$AW_WORK/ansible.cfg" <<EOF
[galaxy]
server_list=artifactweave
[galaxy_server.artifactweave]
url=$AW_URL/artifactory/api/ansible/$AW_REPO/
username=$AW_USER
password=$AW_TOKEN
EOF
configure.note: 0600 temporary configuration; use the trailing slash. Do not commit this expanded file.

publish.note: Publish to a local or one-node federated repository. Remote repositories are read-through caches; select the local deployment member when reading through a virtual.

steps.code:
env HOME="$AW_WORK/home" ANSIBLE_CONFIG="$AW_WORK/ansible.cfg" ANSIBLE_GALAXY_CACHE_DIR="$AW_WORK/cache" ansible-galaxy collection build ./collection --output-path "$AW_WORK"
env HOME="$AW_WORK/home" ANSIBLE_CONFIG="$AW_WORK/ansible.cfg" ANSIBLE_GALAXY_CACHE_DIR="$AW_WORK/cache" ansible-galaxy collection publish "$AW_WORK/weave-sample-1.0.0.tar.gz" --import-timeout 30
steps.note: collection/ contains galaxy.yml for weave.sample 1.0.0; publish required dependency collections first.

install.note: Select a local, remote, virtual or one-node federated repository with read permission. Dependencies must also be available through that repository.

steps.code: env HOME="$AW_WORK/home" ANSIBLE_CONFIG="$AW_WORK/ansible.cfg" ANSIBLE_GALAXY_CACHE_DIR="$AW_WORK/cache" ansible-galaxy collection install weave.sample:==1.0.0 -p "$AW_WORK/installed"
steps.note: Use a newly created AW_WORK for each independent install.

limitations: Collection APIs are supported; this recipe does not claim legacy Galaxy role support.
The pinned client requires Python 3.14 here; the Python 3.15 base failed its dataclasses integration.

contains: Galaxy rejects invalid credentials for metadata reads and publication
